sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT substr(t.txn_date,1,4) year,c.category_code,c.category_name,t.[sale/return] kind,t.[qty_sold(kg)] q,t.[unit_selling_px_rmb/kg] sp,w.[whsle_px_rmb-kg] wp,l.[loss_rate_%] rate FROM veg_txn_df t JOIN veg_whsle_df w ON t.item_code=w.item_code AND t.txn_date=w.whsle_date JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code=c.item_code JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON t.item_code=l.item_code), modes AS (SELECT 'net_all' mode UNION ALL SELECT 'sale_only'), j AS (SELECT mode,joined.* FROM joined CROSS JOIN modes WHERE mode='net_all' OR kind='sale') SELECT mode,year,category_code,category_name,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(AVG(wp),2) avg_wp,ROUND(MAX(wp),2) max_wp,ROUND(MIN(wp),2) min_wp,ROUND(MAX(wp)-MIN(wp),2) diff_wp,ROUND(SUM(q*wp),2) cost,ROUND(SUM(q*sp),2) revenue,ROUND(AVG(rate),2) avg_rate,ROUND(SUM(q*wp)*AVG(rate)/100.0,2) loss_product_averages,ROUND(SUM(q*wp*rate/100.0),2) loss_rowwise,ROUND(SUM(q*sp)-SUM(q*wp)-SUM(q*wp)*AVG(rate)/100.0,2) profit_product,ROUND(SUM(q*sp)-SUM(q*wp)-SUM(q*wp*rate/100.0),2) profit_rowwise FROM j GROUP BY mode,year,category_code,category_name ORDER BY mode,year,category_code
